narr: Thunderstorms developed along a cold front. Some of these storms produced heavy rain that fell in areas that had received significant rain in the previous two days. This additional rain led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced 1.81 inches of rain in just over an hour in western Bexar County where significant rain had fallen in the previous two days. This new rain flooded five low water crossings and caused urban street flooding.
